name: Sex/Life
description: A woman's daring sexual past collides with her married-with-kids present when the bad-boy ex she can't stop fantasizing about crashes back into her life.

videos.title: The Wives Are in Connecticut
videos.overview: Frustrated by the waning passion in her marriage, Billie starts journaling about — and obsessing over — her wild erotic exploits with ex-boyfriend Brad.

videos.title: Down in the Tube Station at Midnight
videos.overview: Billie's emotional rollercoaster of a day turns into an arousing night out when Cooper attempts to reignite the spark in their relationship.

videos.title: Empire State of Mind
videos.overview: While Cooper decides to check out the competition, Billie dwells on the passionate highs and soul-crushing lows that defined her romance with Brad.

videos.title: New New York
videos.overview: Billie's outing with her fellow moms stirs up memories of Brad — and has her making a beeline for Sasha. Cooper unloads his marital worries.

videos.title: The Sound of the Suburbs
videos.overview: As her thoughts continue to drift back to the connection she shared with Brad, Billie proposes a plan to put Cooper's mind at ease about her journal.

videos.title: Somewhere Only We Know
videos.overview: Billie seeks help to untangle her feelings about her marriage and Brad. Cooper receives a tempting proposition after a rewarding day at work.

videos.title: Small Town Saturday Night
videos.overview: As Brad broods over the mistakes he made with Billie, she and Cooper bite off more than they can chew in a bid to spice up their marriage.

videos.title: This Must Be the Place
videos.overview: Faced with the repercussions of their double date with Devon and Trina, Billie and Cooper arrive at a make-or-break moment in their marriage.

videos.title: Welcome to New York
videos.overview: In the middle of starting over, Billie steps out of her comfort zone for a night of fun. Sasha rekindles an old flame, and Cooper ignites a new passion.

videos.title: Georgia on My Mind
videos.overview: Overwhelmed by changes at home, Brad reminisces about the past. Billie takes a stand during a visit from her mother. Sasha's career and love life clash.

videos.title: Seasons of Love
videos.overview: Billie enjoys a blissful romantic interlude. Sasha unveils her relationship in a big way. Cooper seizes a tempting opportunity that soon backfires.

videos.title: The Weakness in Me
videos.overview: As Brad seeks comfort in a moment of crisis, Sasha does damage control, Billie's spa day turns awkward, and Cooper faces fallout from his life choices.

videos.title: Future Starts Today
videos.overview: Billie looks to make a fresh start amid an emotional day. Sasha's soaring success isn't what she expected. Cooper's wild night swerves out of control.

videos.title: Heavenly Day
videos.overview: A fiery incident brings revelations to light for Billie as Cooper confronts his demons, and a joyous celebration of love leads to new beginnings for all.
